title: SCKit: first-wave count now carries Huntress's own qualifier
what_changed: Summary said rogue clients reached 288 hosts; Huntress says 'At least 288 hosts across 48 organizations'. Now 'at least 288'. Added Rapid7's CVE-2026-127063 entry for the RMM+ extension's default static API secret and Cybersecurity Dive's report that ConnectWise disabled RMM+ extensions at about 400 environments.
